new_source.title: Energieregeling, Annex 1, Part B: G-gas at injection into a connection or system coupling

evidence_class: mixed historical literature and official statutory requirements; see row-level source metadata
license_or_rights: Government publication link; reuse governed by the source publication terms and applicable Dutch open-government rules. No CC license is asserted for the aggregated dataset.
processing: Direct transcription of legal requirements; split ranges into bounds. Preserved original units and country, network category, conditions and footnote applicability. No methane minimum was inferred.
runtime_policy: Reference-only. Not linked to parameter registry, runtime defaults, upgrading performance or product-price qualification.
limitations: The Dutch G-gas table is not an operator acceptance for the project connection.
No single minimum methane fraction is stated in Annex 1 Part B.
Pressure, standard-volume convention, exact injection point, exceptions and off-taker acceptance must be confirmed for the intended project.
The conditional CO2 equation is registered but is blocked from runtime use until required typed inputs and exception applicability are resolved.
Historical comparison records from 2009 and Danish 2020 remain intact and must not be merged with the 2026 Dutch requirements.
